description: What each weekly catalogue sync changed: publications added and removed, and price changes, newest first. Filter by a date (only newer syncs), a maximum price, one or more categories, a minimum Domain Authority, additions only, or price drops only — so an agent can watch for new outlets or cheaper placements without re-reading the whole catalogue.

categories.description: Only publications in any of these categories.

category.description: Only publications in a category, e.g. "Crypto".

maxPrice.description: Only publications at or under this price, in USD.

minDomainAuthority.description: Only publications at or above this Moz Domain Authority.

newOnly.description: Only additions — the weekly "what's new" watch.

since.description: ISO date; only syncs after it. Use the newest date you have seen.

name: get_catalog_changes
title: Catalogue changes
